Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Chevron Bar Cabinet, Light Gray Wood

Deliver a serving of style to your guests along with the beverages and snacks. They're sure to be impressed by the beautiful gray distressed wood of this bar cart. Item Dimensions: 31.1”H x13.8”Dx30.5”W Assembly in 30 minutes or less; just screw on legs Compartments for storing wine bottle and wine glasses Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
